notes: G1 of the study pre-registered in validation/protocols/flow-pulse-external-references-v1.md. The spill level is compared because it is the quantity PitRemove outputs: a fill to the exact spill level with no gradient.

Three runs: crop A and crop B with NoData as an outlet, and crop B again with NoData as a wall. All three are identical to TauDEM on every valid cell, and Priority-Flood reached every valid cell in each.
This is one of four studies TERRAIN-FLOW-PULSE needed for E4. The other three compare D8 direction, catchment and accumulation against GRASS GIS 8.3.2.

reference.containerPinningNote: The reference was not executed here. Its authors ran it and published the output on Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.8335853); the run log records the command and the PitRemove version but no executable path or container. The bytes compared are pinned by sha256 in the dataset register instead.
reference.executablePath: Taudem-TauDEM_for_Bear_Creek.zip/intermediates/pitfill.tif (published output; the run log names the command, not the executable path)

datasets.description: The TauDEM for Bear Creek archive: a USGS NED DEM and TauDEM 5.3.8 PitRemove filled elevation, 5523 x 2396 cells in EPSG:4326. Acquired, not vendored.
Crop A, rows 1946 to 2201 and columns 828 to 1083: 65,536 valid cells, 62 TauDEM depressions.
Crop B, rows 2120 to 2375 and columns 2407 to 2662: 53,583 valid cells and 11,953 NoData cells reaching the border, 125 TauDEM depressions.

parameterSets.description: Priority-Flood with NoData read as an outlet, as TauDEM PitRemove reads it. The compared quantity is the spill level, which excludes the epsilon gradient by definition, so the epsilon setting cannot change it.

candidateParameters.rowOrder: fixture rows reversed so row 0 is south

parameterSets.description: Priority-Flood with NoData read as a wall, the Flow Pulse default, on crop B only. NoData that reaches the grid border is outside the surface either way, and every NoData region of crop B reaches it, so the result is expected to equal the outlet run.

candidateParameters.rowOrder: fixture rows reversed so row 0 is south

metrics.toleranceUnit: metre, after casting both sides to Float32

statusReason: All 172,702 compared cells are equal after casting to Float32 (65,536 on crop A, 53,583 on crop B as outlet, 53,583 on crop B as wall). Nothing was widened.

unsupported: Enclosed NoData. Neither crop has a NoData region the surface encloses, so the wall and outlet readings of a survey hole were not told apart.
The epsilon gradient. The compared spill level excludes it by definition, so the routed surface's small rises are not checked here.
Crops chosen as windows where a crop-edge fill reproduces the whole-grid fill; they are not a random sample.
D8 tie order and flat resolution.
Flow length and the Rational-method peak-flow estimate (TERRAIN-FLOW-RATIONAL-PEAK).
Accuracy against the ground. Agreement with another program is not field validation, and archival data cannot reach E5.
